liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Reviewer thinks this may be the best Scarlet Begonias they have heard; Reviewer says Scarlet has no real jam, and the Fire is so-so [19][25]
- **It's Al Over Now** (1 review): Reviewer calls It's All Over Now rare and notes Deadlists.com lacks it [19]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Jerry's solo in Bertha is called outstanding [19]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): Keith plays unusual drony parts in Slipknot [25]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): About five minutes in, Jerry's peak solo and Phil's bass blasts whip the crowd into a frenzy [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-04-23.sbd.aj.gardner.4334.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 179 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1977-04-23.mtx.seamons.97596.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 193 min; rated 4.75/5 by 36 [2]. Said about its sound: Row Jimmy has mild crackle in a few places [2]
- **gd77-04-23.hopkins.vernon.17178.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 195 min; rated 4.6/5 by 10 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording in which Jerry's guitar sits a little low in the mix [15]
- **gd77-04-23.moore.minches.18438.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 189 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [5]
- **gd77-04-23.sbd.jerugim.1827.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 179 min; rated 4.58/5 by 55 [8]. Said about its sound: Matrix recording is strikingly clear and fresh sounding, as if made very recently; Reviewer says the discomfort from one era backup singer is minimal on this tape; Clear soundboard-based recording with smooth patches [16][17][18][22][24]

## Around the show

- Tunings between songs run long [18]
- Show has both Scarlet>Fire and Help>Slip>Frank; reviewer says 3-18 held the first Scarlet>Fire [23]
- Reviewer is surprised it is downloaded less than the Swing show and 5/8/77 [24]
- Reviewer finds it less good than other 1977 shows and not essential [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-04-23.sbd.aj.gardner.4334.shnf**: transferred by AJ and Tony Gardner; source: SBD->MR->DAT->CD [1]. Also: Audience patch via CD, EAC and SHN, uploaded by AJ in September 2000; seed from Sam Esla; Retracked and shortened by Tony Gardner in April 2001, with tuning tracks appended to previous tracks [1]
- **gd1977-04-23.mtx.seamons.97596.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [2]. Also: Taped by Steve Hopkins on Sony ECM99A into Sony 152TC, then cassette, DAT and CD; Transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller, using Samplitude and FLAC [2]
- **gd77-04-23.hopkins.vernon.17178.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Hopkins; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM 99A [3]. Also: Steve Hopkins taped with Sony ECM99A and Sony 152TC; passed via David Minor, encoded by Matt Vernon [3]
- **gd77-04-23.moore.minches.18438.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by David Minches; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-33Ps [5]. Also: Jerry Moore recorded with Sony ECM-33P mics and Sony 153, pole mounted behind center, floor level; Cassette played on Nak Dragon, then digitized and encoded by David Minches using Cool Edit 2000 [5]
- **gd77-04-23.sbd.jerugim.1827.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard with audience patches [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead 4/23/1977 Springfield SBD 2CD | #4826579602](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead23-1977-springfield-sbd-4826579602) [27]
